1.consolidated_definition: alim. Papas fritas. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Véase fries. Quiere que las french fries no vuelvan a cambiar su nombre y que todo americano siga soñando con ver la Torre Eiffel al menos una vez en su vida (Diario de América, 23- 11-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Food. French fries. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. See fries. It wants the french fries not to change their name again and for every American to continue dreaming of seeing the Eiffel Tower at least once in their life (Diario de América, 23-11-07)
